RIMEDANCERMOD-RIME.description: Creatures with [gold]Rime[/gold] give the source of unblocked non-attack damage [gold]Block[/gold]. When dealt unblocked non-attack damage [gold]Rime[/gold] is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
RIMEDANCERMOD-RIME.smartDescription: When dealt unblocked non-attack damage, give the source [blue]{Amount:abs()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and [gold]Rime[/gold] is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].

RIMEDANCERMOD-FERVOR.description:
Fervor increases the effectiveness of [gold]Orbs[/gold] you channel and [gold]Spells[/gold] you play.
Fervor is reduced by [blue]1[/blue] upon activation

Fervor increases the effectiveness of Spells by [blue]{Amount:abs()}[/blue] then [gold]Fervor[/gold] is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
After you channel an Orb increase its effectiveness by [blue]{Amount:abs()} then [gold]Fervor[/gold] is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
RIMEDANCERMOD-FERVOR.title: Fervor
RIMEDANCERMOD-BARRAGE.description: After you [gold]Evoke[/gold] an [gold]Orb[/gold] lose [blue]1[/blue] Orb Slot.

RIMEDANCERMOD-FROST_FEVER.description: Creatures with [gold]Frost Fever[/gold] lose HP equal to the highest amount among debuffs they have and reduces the debuff with the highest amount by [blue]1[/blue].
RIMEDANCERMOD-FROST_FEVER.smartDescripti: At the end of turn, lose HP equal to the highest amount among your debuffs and reduce the debuff with the highest amount by [blue]1[/blue].
RIMEDANCERMOD-FROST_FEVER.title: Frost Fever
RIMEDANCERMOD-RIGGED_GAMBIT.smartDescrip: When attacked, the attacker becomes [gold]Aimed[/gold] and [gold]Fire[/gold] [blue]{Amount:abs()}[/blue].
RIMEDANCERMOD-RIGGED_GAMBIT.title: Rigged Gambit
RIMEDANCERMOD-EXPLOSIVE_RUNE.description:
This trap absorbs all unblocked attack damage for you.
When this trap takes damage, it explodes dealing damage back to all enemies.
RIMEDANCERMOD-EXPLOSIVE_RUNE.title: Explosive Rune
